name: Jihoon Lee
role: Ph.D. Student in Electrical & Electronic Engineering
intro: I study wireless systems that preserve task performance under communication and computing constraints. My work spans semantic token communication, distributed vehicle control, and GPU sharing for AI-and-RAN systems.
about: I am a Ph.D. student at Yonsei University, advised by Prof. Seong-Lyun Kim in the Robotic and Mobile Networks Laboratory. I combine analytical modeling, algorithm design, and experimental systems to study communication under mobility and uncertainty. My current work investigates how RAN workload information can guide GPU sharing between radio processing and AI inference.

research.label: Current research · AI-and-RAN
research.title: Sharing GPUs with the RAN in mind.
research.description: RAN-aware routing of AI inference between shared and disjoint GPU execution contexts. On an NVIDIA H100 testbed, I study how changing RAN workloads affect GPU contention and how adaptive sharing can improve AI throughput while respecting PHY timing constraints.

research.label: Semantic communication
research.title: Protecting meaning, beyond bits.
research.description: Hierarchical token-to-bit mapping, unequal power allocation, and model-assisted recovery for reliable semantic communication. I also study how channel-posterior information can guide masked language models during token reconstruction.

research.label: Connected mobility
research.title: Coordinating vehicles over the air.
research.description: Joint communication and control for vehicle platoons. AirCons exploits wireless signal superposition to share aggregate state information without individual channel-state feedback.

research.label: 6G air interface
research.title: Keeping beams aligned in motion.
research.description: Position-aware MAC design and stochastic-geometry analysis of beam misalignment, with a focus on access probability, beamwidth, and the trade-off between alignment overhead and throughput.

projects.title: RAN-Aware Adaptive GPU Sharing for AI-and-RAN Systems
